newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich urges China trust its own citizens.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich urges China trust its own citizens.

text.p: House of Representatives Speaker Newt Gingrich called on China's government on Saturday to "learn to trust the goodness of its own people."
In an Easter message released by his office as he toured China, the Georgia Republican said the Beijing government must do more than "just cooperate with other countries."

"It must learn to trust in the goodness of its own people," he said. "As our world becomes closer and closer by the day, we realize that there is no place for abuse in what must be considered the Family of Mankind.
"There is no place for torture and arbitrary detention. There is no place for forced confessions. There is no place for intolerance of dissent."
Gingrich said the freedom to speak, assemble and worship were the essential ingredients of "a creative culture, an industrious peoople and a thriving society."
"In this season of resurrection and renewal, Americans are thankful for the opportunity to share our experiences with the Chinese government and the Chinese people," he added.

In a speech to students at Beijing's Institute of Diplomacy on Saturday, Gingrich said the United States cannot remain silent about "the basic lack of freedom -- speech, religion, assembly, the press -- in China."

"In the most basic sense, we are simply asking the Chinese government to enforce its own constitution," he said, dismissing Beijing's criticism that such demands were interference in its internal affairs.
